quarterly_data.signal: CFO Makoto Tanaka (Q1 FY2027 results briefing): core operating cash flow rose JPY 646 hundred million year on year to JPY 2,809 hundred million and profit for the period rose JPY 1,025 hundred million to JPY 2,941 hundred million, a record for a first quarter, both well ahead of the business plan. By segment (accounting general manager Kurihara): Mineral & Metal Resources JPY 612 hundred million (copper, iron ore and coking coal prices, higher iron ore volume); Energy JPY 344 hundred million (FVTPL gain on the IPO of an overseas energy business, US gas); Mobility, Digital & Infrastructure JPY 730 hundred million (autos, gas infrastructure); Chemicals JPY 266 hundred million; Wellness Ecosystem JPY 184 hundred million; Innovation & Corporate Development JPY 652 hundred million, up JPY 549 hundred million on an asset-recycling gain from the restructuring of CIM Group and an FVTPL valuation gain on the IPO of a quantum computing business. Foreign exchange added JPY 170 hundred million and market prices JPY 140 hundred million.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 profit JPY 2,941 hundred million (+1,025); core operating cash flow JPY 2,809 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (Q1 FY2027 results briefing, CFO Makoto Tanaka): Mitsui will review its full-year forecast at the appropriate time, normally with Q2 results, and sees some possibility of an upward revision to core operating cash flow; Q1 progress above 30% of plan is high because Q1 is usually its weakest quarter; Energy should contribute fully from Q2 on LNG and asset-recycling gains, with large LNG dividends and LNG logistics profits weighted to the second half; the Waitsia Australian gas business began contributing this quarter and a US solar power business completed within budget is expected to contribute from Q2; the investment pipeline exceeds JPY 6 trillion, and ROE of 12% for the year to March 2029 is a must-achieve target.
quarterly_data.figure: investment pipeline over JPY 6 trillion; ROE 12% target

quarterly_data.signal: Business views (Q1 FY2027 results briefing): CFO Makoto Tanaka said chemicals trading is supplying solutions (product, logistics, storage tanks, tankers) in markets tightened by the Middle East situation; methanol output in the Middle East cannot ship, but the US plant, using cost-competitive US gas and selling at strong international prices, more than offsets it, a situation he expects to last for some time; autos are building profits mainly in North and South America; poultry demand stays firm. Iron ore production is running above the initial assumption, mainly on solid Rio Tinto operations (Hashimoto), with the full-year view to be reviewed after Q2; the BHP strike's impact is seen as limited; China's property slump continues, while AI-related demand and EV exports are firm. Coking coal fell short of plan on rain at Dawson and higher diesel costs; commodity derivative trading is well above plan.

Deals (Q1 FY2027 results briefing, CFO Makoto Tanaka): the proposed acquisition of the free-float shares of Penske Automotive Group (PAG) would be funded from the management allocation; Mitsui has worked with Penske Corporation for many years, including in truck leasing, and runs its own truck auction business. On portfolio review, Mitsui agreed terms to sell its stake in Soda Koryo (a profitable company) to a new shareholder; ROIC-based screening of businesses against industry WACC has started, with no sale or exit from it yet.
